text:
ashley: quick ping — opened PR #5923 that changes batching heuristic + tweaks KV cache TTL + adds a tiny attention-kernel guard. Want to merge into canary today and run a short perf sweep. PTAL when you have a min: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5923

kevin: can take a look in ~30m. what's failing in CI?

ashley: CI is showing a flaky unit failure: `test_batch_alignment`. Repro locally with `pytest tests/test_batcher.py::test_batch_alignment -q`. Error: AssertionError: expected batch size <= 8 got 12

hao: I can reproduce on my workstation. looks like prefetch TTL + batching window can align into a bigger batch in edge timing. quick inspect: the TTL default was 10s, changing to 5s avoids the collision for the small seq workloads.

liz: quick nit — can you add an inline comment in batching.go explaining why we floor to block size? took me a bit to read the math. also add a unit test for the off-by-one case.

ci-bot: build #5923 — tests: 117 passed, 3 failed. Rerun? :rotating_light:

sam: before merging to canary, can we gate this behind a feature flag? e.g. `RELEASE_FLAG=kv_batch_v2` so we can canary traffic and have quick fallback.

ashley: good call. pushed an update that gates the new heuristic behind `kv_batch_v2` and reduced TTL to 5s in default profile for the branch. also added the extra unit test per Liz. run bench locally with: `./bench --seq=128 --qps=50 --flags kv_batch_v2`

kevin: LGTM pending green CI and a quick perf number (p50/p95). If frank can run on dedicated GPUs that'd be ideal.

frank: I'll run a short benchmark on the dev cluster in ~30m. will report p50/p95 and token/s.

liz: also please add a short note in the PR description on rollback steps (kubectl rollout undo + feature flag off). small docs save time during incidents.

ashley: added rollback steps to PR body and a short runbook snippet: ```# rollback plan
# 1) flip feature flag: ./admin/flags set kv_batch_v2 false
# 2) kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/runtime-canary
# 3) revert PR if further fixes needed: git revert <sha>
```

kevin: sounds good. if CI is green and frank's bench looks ok i'll approve and merge to canary at the 16:30 PT merge window.

frank: bench results (dedicated a100s): baseline (old): p50=14ms p95=95ms tokens/sec=8500. with kv_batch_v2: p50=12ms p95=88ms tokens/sec=9100. memory stable. 7% throughput up, small latency win. :thumbsup:

liz: thanks frank — that's convincing. left one tiny remark on comment formatting, non-blocking.

ci-bot: all checks passed for PR #5923 — CI green. :white_check_mark:

kevin: approved and merged into canary. :tada:

ashley: thanks everyone — I'll watch SLO dashboards for the next hour and have the rollback steps ready. tagging @oncall in case anything pops.

oncall: thanks for the heads up — i'll keep an eye on traces and can roll back if we see error spikes.

ashley: appreciate it — will post a short update after the 1h observation window.
